clips.title: The CLAUDE.md file
clips.why: Anthropic's own three-minute explanation of CLAUDE.md: what to put in it, how the files in different folders work together, and how to keep it effective.
look: What the video says belongs in the file, and compare it with fcp's map: layout, commands, PR style.
How the hierarchy of CLAUDE.md files in different folders fits together.
Its tips for keeping the file effective, and which of them is about length.
clips.after: fcp's root file follows this advice and stops at the map; everything area-specific goes into rules that load by path.

clips.title: Stop Writing Bad CLAUDE.md Files
clips.why: The first tip is the one our hook is about: the size of the file every session reads.
look: Why a long CLAUDE.md costs more than tokens.
What size the speaker aims for, and how it compares with the documented target of under 200 lines.
clips.after: That is why fcp's map stays short and the 1,400 lines of conventions never go into it.

clips.title: Stop Writing Bad CLAUDE.md Files
clips.why: Progressive disclosure is the general name for the layers in this lesson: give the model a little up front and the rest when it needs it.
look: What progressive disclosure means for an instruction file.
Where the extra detail lives instead, and how the model finds it.
clips.after: Our version has three steps: the map at launch, area rules when a matching file opens, and brain pages when the kb skill fetches them.

clips.title: Claude Code best practices | Code w/ Claude
clips.why: A short section from Anthropic's best-practices talk on what a team's CLAUDE.md is for.
look: Which kinds of content the speaker says belong in a shared CLAUDE.md.
How the file is shared with the team, and why that makes it worth reviewing like code.
clips.after: fcp's root map is a shared file in the repo, so it changes through a pull request and a reviewer who did not ask for the change.

practice.q: Which line belongs in fcp's root CLAUDE.md?

options.text: "Cloud, client and sdk CI run on push; frontend CI runs on pull requests."
options.why: Almost every session that pushes code needs it, and it is one line.

options.text: "Use CommonRhinoTestCase and the factory_boy factories in rhinoCore/tests/test_factories/."
options.why: True, but only for cloud work. It belongs in the cloud rule.

options.text: The full page on how a code run reaches the on-prem client
options.why: Deep knowledge few sessions need. It lives in the brain, reached through the kb skill.

practice.q: Finish the frontmatter so the frontend rule loads for every file under frontend/, at any depth.
practice.hint: Two characters that match any number of folders.
practice.why: frontend/** matches frontend/src/app/page.tsx; frontend/* would match only files directly in frontend/.

practice.q: Nova opens Claude Code at the fcp root and starts on RH-1234. Put the loading in order.
items: The root CLAUDE.md and the rules without paths load at launch
Nova opens frontend/src/app/page.tsx with the Read tool
frontend/AGENTS.md (through frontend/CLAUDE.md) and the frontend rule load
Nova needs to know why frontend CI runs only on pull requests and calls the kb skill
kb search returns the CI page with its citation and confidence
practice.why: Each layer arrives only when the work reaches it, so the frontend ticket never pays for the cloud rule.

practice.q: Someone wants to paste the company's data-retention policy into the brain "so agents can find it". What do you suggest?

options.text: Paste it, with the policy owner as the page owner
options.why: It would be a second copy of text whose real home is Vanta. The copy goes stale while agents trust it.

options.text: Add a pointer: policy questions go to Vanil's connector, and pages link to the policy instead of pasting it
options.why: One source of truth, with an owner who already keeps it current.

options.text: Put it in the root CLAUDE.md
options.why: Every session would pay for it, and it would still be a copy that goes stale.

practice.q: A 900-line CLAUDE.md is split into five files joined with @imports. What happens to the context each session pays for?

options.text: It drops to the size of the root file
options.why: Imported files are expanded and loaded at launch together with the file that imports them.
Imports organise the text; they do not delay loading. Only subfolders and paths do.

options.text: It grows, because imports are loaded twice
options.why: Each file loads once. The cost is the same as before.
